```{webr}
#| autorun: true
#| input:
#|   - landings_data
# SHARED LANDINGS GUARD — include it right after {{< include _landings-data.qmd >}}, with:
#     {{< include _landings-guard.qmd >}}
# Turns the fetched rows into the data frame every lesson box refers to as `landings`.
# When there is no data (not signed in, or the session has expired) it falls back to an EMPTY frame that
# still HAS the columns the lessons name. That way the boxes below return an empty table instead of
# reporting a missing column — a message the learner would read as their own spelling mistake.
# If a lesson starts referring to another column, add it here too.
landings <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(landings_data), error = function(e) data.frame())

if (nrow(landings) == 0) {
  landings <- data.frame(
    landing_date = character(), gaul_2_name = character(), gear = character(),
    catch_taxon  = character(), catch_kg = numeric()
  )
  cat("Not signed in, so the boxes below will come back empty.\n")
  cat("Open this lesson from the Data Explorer tab while signed in to load your records.\n")
} else {
  cat("Ready:", nrow(landings), "of your landing records are loaded, under the name landings.\n")
}
```
